sections.title: Behind the worlds
sections.intro:
A little curiosity.
A lot of play.

blocks.text: Hey, I’m **Oskar**. I build experiences that live between **art and code** — with a soft spot for playful systems, procedural worlds, and the little details that make a game feel alive.
For me, the fun is in the unexpected. A simple rule that leads to a surprising moment. A world that never plays quite the same way twice.

Design with curiosity
Build, play, break, repeat
Make room for the unexpected

sections.title: Pick your next portal.
sections.intro: Different worlds. The same restless curiosity.

blocks.text: I like to start small: one mechanic, one question, one playful prototype. Then I follow the interesting parts.

**Explore** — find the feeling before the feature list.
**Prototype** — turn the question into something playable.
**Iterate** — let the game surprise you.
